name: Detritus
description: Dead plant material and other non-living soil organic matter, the main energy source of this below-ground web. Functional group aggregating the three detritus compartments of the source model (numbered 3, 5 and 7 in the source figure), pooled because the web's consumers draw on them as one resource. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
